title.narrative: TRAction: The Turkish Alliance for Climate Action and Beyond

description.narrative:
Overall objective of this action is to contribute to the net-zero transformation and climate ambition in Turkey through improving the impact of civil society organisations (CSOs).

Specific objectives of the action are the following:

-      To extend opportunities to Green and Business CSOs to strengthen their technical know-how and professional skills which will feed into aiding each other and their networks for more ambitious climate action.

And through, the alliance-building approach to further contribute to CSOs¿ capacities by facilitating dialogue with one another as well as the business community, expanding their networks, and creating opportunities for collaboration with increased impact.

The contract was awarded under the call for proposal that aims to support the improvement of the capacities of civil society organisations towards the achievement of the ambitious targets of the European Green Deal.
